_source: Declared 2026-07-31 against story/data/physics_catalog.json (158 rows, 23 branches). Covers five branches: E4 ELECTROMAGNETISM, E5 OPTICS, E6 RELATIVITY, E7 QUANTUM MECHANICS, E8 NUCLEAR PHYSICS. Every row id here was READ OUT of the catalog by matching the row's own `name` and `equation`; not one was typed from memory. Rows whose variables are not unambiguous scalars, or that need a unit folding.UNITS does not carry, are ABSENT ON PURPOSE and listed in _skipped -- an unbound row is honest, a guessed signature makes a bad bond look legal.

_skipped.E4.02 Coulomb & Lorentz force: F = q(E + v x B) needs coulomb, volt/metre and tesla-as-a-field-input. UNITS has T_mag and uT but no C and no V/m, so two of the three consumed symbols cannot be stated.
_skipped.E4.03 Circuits: Ohm/Kirchhoff/RC need volt, ampere and ohm. None exist in UNITS.
_skipped.E4.05 Antennas & links: Friis is unambiguous and its units (W, 1, m) all exist -- but there is no comms membrane anywhere in the tree and no membrane declares a transmit power, an antenna gain or a link range. Every key fragment would be invented. Left out until theScan is a membrane rather than a verb.
_skipped.E4.06 Motors & generators: EMF = -dPhi/dt needs volt and weber. Neither exists in UNITS.
_skipped.E4.07 Batteries: Nernst E = E0 - RT/nF lnQ needs volt and a reaction quotient. Volt does not exist in UNITS.
_skipped.E4.08 Magnetosphere/plasma basics: Debye shielding needs a number density (1/m3, absent) and frozen-in flux is a field condition with no scalar in/out. aActiveInterior's `magnetopause_radii` is a pressure balance, not either of the row's stated equations, and its key carries no declared unit.
_skipped.E4.09 Superconductivity: Meissner effect and BCS have no scalar in/out at this level and no membrane is anywhere near them.
_skipped.E5.04 Photometry/radiometry: THE ONE OPTICS ROW BLOCKED PURELY BY THE UNITS TABLE. The whole content of the row is the conversion between a radiometric power and a V(lambda)-weighted photometric quantity, and UNITS carries no photometric unit at all -- no cd, lm, lx or cd/m2 -- even though DIMS reserves J for luminous intensity. Declaring it as W/m2 -> W/m2 would erase exactly the distinction the row exists for.
_skipped.E5.06 Lasers (physics of): Stimulated emission and population inversion have no clean scalar signature (an inversion is a number-density difference, 1/m3; a threshold gain is 1/m -- neither unit exists). theSkin names a laser graze in its open agenda but states honestly that damage-as-an-energy is not derived yet.
_skipped.E6.03 General relativity: G_mu_nu = 8*pi*G/c^4 * T_mu_nu is a tensor field equation. There is no scalar in and no scalar out; its two usable scalar consequences ARE declared, at E6.04 and E6.05.
_skipped.E7.01 Schroedinger equation: A wave equation for psi. No scalar in, no scalar out.
_skipped.E7.02 Hydrogen atom: E_n = -13.6 eV/n^2. eV does not exist in UNITS, and the quantity this tree actually takes from it -- 13.6 eV setting recombination at 3760 K in theCooling -- reaches the tree through Saha, which is a thermodynamics row and another agent's branch.
_skipped.E7.03 Pauli exclusion: A statement about states, not an equation with scalars. (theStar does USE it -- the Fermi temperature in its degeneracy limit -- but that arrives as E8.04's maximum temperature, declared there.)
_skipped.E7.04 Quantum tunneling: T ~ e^(-2*kappa*L) needs kappa in 1/m. UNITS has 1/s and 1/min but no 1/m.
_skipped.E7.06 Quantum statistics: Two distributions rather than one law, and nothing in the tree evaluates an occupancy.
_skipped.E7.07 Band theory: Band gaps are quoted in eV, which UNITS lacks, and no membrane has a semiconductor in it.
_skipped.E7.08 Semiconductors & junctions: I = I_s(e^(qV/kT)-1) needs ampere and volt. Neither exists in UNITS.
_skipped.E8.02 Decay chains & activity: The Bateman equations are a coupled ODE system over a chain. There is no single scalar in and out to declare.
_skipped.E8.05 Fission (energy balance only): ~200 MeV per U-235 fission needs MeV (absent), and no membrane publishes a fissile inventory. Stated as kg -> J it would only duplicate E6.02's fold under an invented key.
_skipped.E8.06 Radiation types & shielding: Attenuation needs a mass attenuation coefficient (1/m or m2/kg, both absent) and DOSE NEEDS THE SIEVERT. UNITS carries N.m/kg and kWh/kg, which share the sievert's dimension L2 T-2 exactly -- so declaring a dose in N.m/kg would be a textbook misfold, a torque-per-mass socket accepting a radiation dose. Skipped rather than faked.
_skipped.E8.07 Radioisotope power: The Seebeck half needs V/K (absent). The energy-balance half (thermal W x efficiency -> electrical W) is clean, but no RTG, reactor or power-plant membrane exists and every key fragment would be invented.

E4.01.note: THE MAGNETOSTATIC DIPOLE SOLUTION -- the one consequence of Maxwell's equations this tree actually derives: B_pole = mu0*m/(2*pi*R^3), with the equatorial field half of it. Declared narrowly on purpose: the full field equations are PDEs with no scalar in or out, so what is stated here is the solution aActiveInterior computes from its geodynamo's dipole moment and the planet's own radius. The regime is what planetary surface fields MEASURE: Mercury 0.3 uT, Earth 25-65 uT, Jupiter ~430 uT. This world derives 22.1 uT at the surface and 11.05 uT at the equator, which is the factor of two a dipole demands.

E4.04.note: Light is an electromagnetic wave and c = 1/sqrt(eps0*mu0) is FINITE, so a distance is a delay: t = d/c. theSolarSystem derives light_time_1au_s = 499.0 s and light_time_edge_s = 14970 s from exactly this, and theClock carries t_light_sun_s. The consumed regime is the astronomical band where the delay is the interesting number: inside 0.01 au you are inside most stars, and past ~100 au you are outside the planet-forming disk this tree grows. THE KEY CARRIES A LEADING UNDERSCORE AND IT IS LOAD-BEARING: the fragment 'au' matches nineteen keys in this tree, among them `vault_point_foot_m` and `tropopause_m`, and the first run of this signature duly bound a 5.5 cm foot vault into an orbital-distance socket, converted it to 3.7e-13 au and reported a MISFOLD against a law that has nothing to do with feet. `_au` matches exactly four keys and all four are astronomical distances. The Poynting half of the row is NOT declared -- no membrane derives a field amplitude, and W/m2 in this tree means geothermal or stellar flux, not E x B.

E5.01.note: SNELL: n1 sin(theta1) = n2 sin(theta2). The regimes are what the quantities ARE, not a taste band: an angle measured from the surface normal cannot exceed 90 degrees, and a passive transparent material's index runs from 1.0 (vacuum) through water 1.34 and glass 1.5 to diamond 2.42, with 4.0 left as headroom for a semiconductor -- below 1.0 is not a material. DOCKS NOWHERE TODAY: nothing publishes a scalar refractive index (aSaltOcean holds n = 1.34 as a module constant inside FRESNEL_R0) and theEye is still a stub. The row also carries the thin lens 1/f = 1/s + 1/s', which is the half theEye will need for field of view; one row gets one signature, and Snell is the row's first equation and the one the air/water and air/visor interfaces need.

E5.02.note: THE RAYLEIGH CRITERION, theta = 1.22*lambda/D -- the hard floor on what any eye, visor or camera can resolve, and therefore the hard floor on the grain size a render has to reach and no finer. The consumed regime is VISIBLE LIGHT, 380-750 nm, written in metres because folding.UNITS has no nm: outside that band the arithmetic still works but it is no longer this world's light. DOCKS NOWHERE TODAY, and the socket is already named for it: theEye's physics.py lists 'acuity: the angular size at which a grain stops being resolvable, which bounds the render' among what it must derive. Nothing yet publishes a scalar wavelength or an aperture diameter.

E5.03.note: THE FRESNEL HALF OF THE ROW, at normal incidence: R0 = ((n-1)/(n+1))^2. This is what aSaltOcean's sun glint IS -- it evaluates FRESNEL_R0 from n = 1.34, gets 0.021, and publishes it as `sunglint_intensity`. THE FINDING: that key carries no unit in its name and is not in units.json, so the single number this law produces in this tree is invisible to every check in folding.py; declaring it (or renaming it to end in _frac) closes the loop. R0's regime is what real dielectrics do at normal incidence -- water 0.021, glass 0.040, diamond 0.17. Malus's law is the row's other half and is not declared here: nothing polarized is derived yet, and aHuman's `visor_transmission` is a broadband transmittance, not a polarizer.

E5.05.note: RAYLEIGH SCATTERING BY A COLUMN OF AIR -- the whole of why a sky is blue and a sunset is red. The scattering optical depth is tau = sigma*n*H, so it scales with the column mass rho_surface * H and as lambda^-4; aNitrogenAtmosphere anchors it on Earth's MEASURED 0.098 at 550 nm and derives 0.0697 at the zenith and 2.65 at the limb for this thinner air, then reads the sky's colour straight off the three channels' taus. THE COLUMN IS CONSUMED AS rho x H, NOT as the published `column_mass_kg_m2`: kg/m2 is not in folding.UNITS at all, and that key ends in `_m2`, so the suffix table reads a column mass as an AREA. `surface_density_kg_m3` and `scale_height_m` are both read correctly and their product is the same physical quantity, so the law is stated in the two numbers that can actually be bound. REGIMES, each with a reason: surface density spans Mars 0.020 to Venus 65 kg/m3 (Earth 1.225, here 0.65); scale height is E3.02's own 100 m to 100 km, the range that caught theAtmosphere drawing its scale height 23x too thick; a clear planetary zenith optical depth at mid-visible runs from ~0.005 (a sky so thin there is barely one) to ~1 (a sky you cannot see the star through).

E5.07.note: WHAT THE IMAGINARY HALF OF A MEASURED REFRACTIVE INDEX MEANS: alpha = 4*pi*k/lambda, so the attenuation length is l = lambda/(4*pi*k). This is the law that turns refractiveindex.info's archived (n, k) into the one number a transmitting material's render needs. aSaltOcean already publishes the PRODUCT -- attenuation_length_m = 57.1 m, from Pope & Fry's measured pure-water absorption at 460 nm plus Morel's backscatter -- but the measured constants themselves live as module constants (ABSORB_RGB) rather than as published numbers, which is exactly why the consumed side docks nowhere. Regimes: visible light 380-750 nm; an attenuation length runs from a metal's ~1 nm skin depth to the ~1 km of the clearest ocean water at blue, and water's own red is 3.1 m against blue's 57 m, which is why water is blue.

E6.01.note: gamma = 1/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2). THE CONSUMED REGIME IS THE POINT of this row's stated relevance, 'honest limits': no published speed may exceed c = 299,792,458 m/s, and this is the only check anywhere in the tree that says so. It docks to several membranes ON PURPOSE and that is not promiscuity -- every speed has a Lorentz factor, and at this tree's speeds (a 335 m/s sound speed, a 0.91 m/s walk) gamma is 1 to twelve decimal places, which is the honest answer rather than a missing one.

E6.02.note: E = mc^2, the plain conversion. It shares a FOLD with E8.03 (binding energy) and that sharing is the fold doing its job: same dimensional shape, different chemistry -- this socket takes any `mass`, that one takes only a `mass_defect`. NO REGIME: a rest energy is not bounded by anything physical, and a plausible-looking band here would be taste wearing a derivation's clothes.

E6.04.note: r_s = 2GM/c^2, and theHorizon literally implements it (`schwarzschild(M)`) -- the seed's first LENGTH, drawn by the one mass the human adds to zero. THE KEY IS DELIBERATELY `M_added` AND NOT `M`: every membrane in this tree publishes something in kilograms, so a socket keyed on the bare 'M' docks to fifteen of them, and inside theHorizon itself the shortest-name tiebreak picks the PLANCK MASS over the membrane's own dial. That is precisely the promiscuity rule 3 exists to stop -- unit is the shape of the site, the name is the chemistry. When theBlackHole is built it should publish a key carrying this fragment, or this key widens then and not before. No regime: r_s is defined for any mass, from 2.3e-35 m at the seed to a kilometre for a star.

E6.05.note: alpha = 4GM/(c^2 b) -- the deflection Eddington MEASURED at the Sun's limb in 1919, 1.75 arcsec = 8.5e-6 rad. Keyed to M_star and R_star because the impact parameter of a GRAZING ray is the body's own radius, and because a star is the only mass in this tree a ray goes past on its way to a camera; theSolarSystem publishes both in SI. The regime is the weak-field condition the formula is derived under and not a preference: 4GM/(c^2 b) = 2 r_s/b, so it only holds while b >> r_s, i.e. while the deflection stays far below a radian.

E7.05.note: E = h*nu -- one photon's energy, the quantity that makes light countable rather than continuous. The regime is VISIBLE light, 400-790 THz, which is the same 750-380 nm band as E5.02 and E5.07 read from the other end; folding.UNITS has neither nm nor eV, so the frequency form is the one that can be stated in units that exist at all. DOCKS NOWHERE TODAY and may stay that way for a while, because this tree speaks in WAVELENGTH (lambda = c/nu) and nothing publishes a scalar frequency. Declared because an engine whose whole subject is light transport eventually needs the photon, and because the row's own equation names nu and not lambda.

E8.01.note: N/N0 = 2^(-t/t_half), the half-life form, because t_half is the number that gets published and lambda is not. THE CONSUMER ALREADY EXISTS AND CANNOT REACH IT: aActiveInterior publishes radiogenic_heat_TW = 12.46 TW, which IS this law applied to U-238, Th-232 and K-40 over the planet's age, but neither a half-life nor an age is published anywhere, so nothing docks. The elapsed time is keyed `_age` with the underscore rather than `age`, which would also match theGround's `sinkage_m` and theTerrain's `drainage_density_per_km` -- both lengths today, so both harmless today, and that is exactly the kind of coincidence that stops being harmless the week someone publishes an age. The produced regime restates what `frac` already forbids, on purpose: it is the check that would catch a decay running backwards.

E8.03.note: The mass a bound nucleus is MISSING, read as an energy through E = mc^2. Same fold as E6.02 and a deliberately narrower socket: this one accepts only a `mass_defect`, which is what a fold plus a key is FOR -- substitutable shape, non-substitutable chemistry. The curve peaking at iron is why theStar fuses at all and why an interior's iron is ash; neither is derived yet, so nothing docks.

E8.04.note: WHETHER A BALL OF GAS CATCHES FIRE, and theStar solves it the honest way round. Contraction raises the virial temperature as 1/R and the Fermi temperature as 1/R^2, so degeneracy always catches up and every ball has a MAXIMUM temperature it will ever reach; the least mass whose maximum still clears the p-p chain's 4.0e6 K is M_min = 1.39e29 kg = 0.070 M_sun, which lands on the measured brown-dwarf limit and was not fitted to it. Keyed to `M_min` so the socket binds theStar's own derived answer and nothing else -- a bare 'M' would bind every kilogram in the tree. REGIMES: hydrogen burns between roughly 0.05 and 150 solar masses (1e29 to 3e32 kg); a hydrogen-burning core sits between 4e6 K, where the p-p chain becomes self-sustaining, and ~1e8 K, by which point the CNO cycle has taken over and helium is next. NOTE FOR theStar: its `T_ignite`, `T_max_at_min` and `T_max_if_never_ignited` all carry no declared unit, so the produced side of this law is currently unreadable even though the membrane derives it.
